what: The photo panel, curled like a cylinder around its top edge (bottom edge rolled toward the screen), rises from 200px below and 120 ahead and flattens over 1.5s to lie in place (WebGL, three). Curl angle = 1/shape × intensity, top edge axis tilt = .25/shape × strength, depth 1.3x — all bound to the unfold 1−(1−p)⁵. The shape value grows the lower the plate is relative to the screen, so small plates appear to bend by the same amount (√(screen height × .65 / plate height), .75~1.35). It starts when 8% of the plate is visible past the bottom 8% of the screen, and once fully unfolded the canvas is cleared and the photo stands in its place

options.motion: Intensity 0–1, default 1 — the three feature photos on the original home are .75
options.fade: Fade-in start length in seconds, default 0 — the original careers and results detail header photo uses .8
options.zoom: Share of zoom-in on the image before it unfolds, default 0 — the original head photo is .12
options.shift: Amount the image is shifted up/down before unfolding (uv), default 0 — the original header photo uses −.05
options.group: Group to start together — ancestor selector (closest). When the group enters, the panels inside start one after another, each delayed by stagger
options.on: Starts when a window event of this name arrives instead of scroll (hero header photo — when the header text rises)
options.text: Past this progress value, an fx:sheet-curl-in:text event is fired on the element, default .35 — the adjacent text rises then
options.min: Not applied below this width (px), default 1024 (the original switches to a regular photo entrance on phones)
options.--fx-z: z-index of the fixed canvas (css), default 5
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo to draw on the panel (child) — The surface’s image — on a .wf-img placeholder surface it draws the background, diagonal and label

note: three is the cjs build at library/_vendor/three@0.185.0, so loading this folder’s three-global.js before it makes it readable as window.THREE. Because the sheets leave their element, all sheets are drawn on a single screen-fixed canvas (.fx-sheet-curl-in) — when every sheet is gone the canvas is removed. If WebGL is unavailable, or under 1024 width or with reduced motion, nothing is attached, so leave the caller’s ordinary entrance (clip etc.) in place for those cases

from.where: index.html message photo·three feature photos (motion .75) · service.html two business photos (group .sv-block, stagger) · recruit.html three Hero photos · detail.html Hero photo (fade .8 · zoom .12 · shift −.05) — original WebGLPlaneReveal: three r185, 1500ms, quint.out, bend 1/shape, tilt .25/shape, depth ×1.3 +120, push up 200, perspective .75, rootMargin 0 0 −8% · threshold .08
